description: Reference for the `scen7-vl-SST-*` experiments and atmosphere-only counterpart of `scen7-vl`. All forcings evolve as in `scen7-vl`, with time-evolving monthly sea-surface temperatures and sea ice prescribed from the model's own `scen7-vl` simulation. Models with emissions that depend on the sea-surface state (e.g. DMS) should also prescribe these from the same simulation. Also the reference for the afforestation/reforestation experiments, so BVOC, fire and dust emissions should be interactive where the model allows.
